---
name: implementation
description: Use when implementing a planned, scoped change in TCE Dashboard.
---

# Implementation Skill

1. Confirm a dedicated task branch and clean, understood working scope.
2. Check existing patterns before creating new abstractions or dependencies.
3. Implement the smallest complete vertical slice.
4. Add/update tests, types, and docs for the changed behavior.
5. Avoid unrelated refactors and preserve public contracts unless a break is required.
6. Run discovered focused checks and broader relevant checks when practical.
7. Inspect the full diff and summarize known gaps without overstating completion.
